tasks.short: Plan the layout of computers and peripherals.

steps.what: Gather information on the room and the equipment.
Plan the layout of computers and peripheral equipment.
Recommend modifications to the planned layout.
Issue the layout plan to the facilities lead.

tasks.design: Room and equipment constraints are fields on {DOCS}: power points, heat, cable length and the computers and peripherals to place. The computer hardware engineer still plans the layout and recommends modifications. The plan is issued to the facilities lead only after that recommendation. This is not a site-design calculation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Layouts were sketches that facilities could not read, redrawn after the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Constraints can be listed once. The layout itself is still a plan the engineer makes.
tasks.still_hard: A room constraint that is not on the drawing until someone stands in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which peripheral will not fit even when the sketch looks clear.
tasks.altitude: Collecting constraints is shorter. The plan and the recommendation stay with the engineer.

reach.task: Draw a room so equipment locations can be checked
reach.learn: Which room facts they need before a layout is drawable

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.
Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from room and equipment information to an issued layout plan. Building works are the facilities lead's task.
Fields are item, location, power need, heat and cable limit. The engineer writes them from the room notes. Fallback: a missing measure is marked unknown and the plan says so.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the constraint list.
unknowns: Whether a measured room plan already exists.
Who approves a layout that changes the building.
research_questions: How often does a site visit overturn the plan?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the room is poorly known and the plan is redone by hand. High case: constraints are listed and the engineer only plans and recommends. The plan stays a judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read dust, temperature and humidity limits for the installation.
Walk the installation area and note the conditions.
Recommend equipment to control dust, temperature and humidity.
Buyer prices the recommended environmental equipment.
Send the purchase requisition for that equipment.

tasks.design: Dust, temperature and humidity limits are fields the computer hardware engineer takes from the hardware specification. The walk of the installation area stays. The engineer recommends the equipment, and a requisition on {PROCUREMENT} goes out only after that recommendation. The buyer prices it. Nothing is purchased automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: The recommendation and the purchase request were the same unchecked mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Limits can be read from the specification. The recommendation after a walk cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A room that meets the numbers and still puts dust or heat on the hardware.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees the installation, not only the limit.

ambition.what: The engineer decides whether the room needs equipment or a different place for the system.

tasks.altitude: Copying limits is shorter. The walk and the recommendation stay, and a requisition waits for them.

reach.task: Say how dust and heat on this line affect the installation
reach.learn: Which site conditions they already measure

evidence.claim: Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.
A cost line can be a quantity times a price the buyer maintains. The engineer still chooses the part.
Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from hardware environment limits and a site walk to a requisition. The purchase order is the buyer's task.

Fields are dust limit, temperature limit, humidity limit, unit and area. The engineer writes them from the hardware specification. Fallback: a limit that is not in the specification is typed and marked manual, and it is not sent until the engineer recommends it.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the environment field list.
unknowns: Whether facilities already logs temperature and humidity.
Whether a requisition needs a second signature from facilities.
research_questions: How often does the walk change the recommendation?
How often is equipment bought that the hardware specification did not require?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the area is unusual and the walk and the recommendation are the work. High case: limits are on file and the engineer still walks and recommends before any requisition.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Layout and site recommendations stay judgements made after looking at the room. Lists of constraints are easier to reuse. The engineer does not gain a right to buy.
reach: Industrial Engineers, on site conditions they already measure.
Architectural and Civil Drafters, on which room facts a layout needs.
skills_to_grow: Saying when a room needs different equipment rather than a different layout.
Marking an unknown measure instead of guessing it.
role.ambitious_version: Facilities receives a layout the engineer has recommended, and a climate requisition waits for the same kind of recommendation.
